main_text.p: Noi parlammo, & habbiamo parlato, wir haben geredt, (locuti sumus.)
Voi parlaste, & hauete parlato, jhr habet geredt, (locuti estis.)
Coloro parlarono, & hanno parlato, sie haben geredt, (locuti sunt.)
main_text.head: Plusquam perfectum.
main_text.l: Io haueua, Tu haueui, Colui haueua, parlato. Locutus eram. Locutus eras. Locutus erat.
Ich, du, er, hatte, hatteft geredt.
Noi haueuamo, Voi haueuate, Coloro haueuano, parlato.
main_text.p: Wir, jhr, sie, hatten, hattet geredt.
main_text.head: Futurum.
main_text.p: Ich, du, er, wir, jhr, sie, werd, wirst, wird, werden, werdet, werden reden.
main_text.head: Imperativo temp. praes.
main_text.l: Parla tu, parla colui, rede du, rede er, (loquere.)

page.notes: Paradigm rows are joined by large braces in the original; the brace groupings are shown inline. The printed marginal page number is 251 at top right. Some words in the paradigm are faint and read with some uncertainty.
